title: RuntimeToolDryRunResult
description: Dry-run assessment result for tool invocation. Content-light: no raw file contents, stdout, stderr, diffs, snippets, or secrets. Only boolean flags, paths, schema validity indicators, and structured error/refusal information.

status.description: Dry-run status. would_prepare = adapter would prepare the envelope. blocked = context/policy blocked. refused = tool/path/payload refused. invalid = envelope or payload failed validation.

invocation_id.description: The invocation ID from the prepared envelope, if available.

intent_id.description: Reference to the original intent ID.

envelope_schema_valid.description: Whether the prepared envelope passed schema validation against the runtime_tool_invocation schema.

tool_schema_valid.description: Whether the tool-specific payload shape passed structural validation.

would_execute.description: Always false — this is a dry run. No tool would be executed.

would_mutate.description: Classification-only: true for write_file and search_replace. No actual mutation occurs.

would_acquire_lease.description: Always false — no lease would be acquired during dry run.

error_kind.description: Structured error kind from blocked/refused/invalid results.

warnings.description: Warnings from the adapter or validation.
